hero.description: Style, quality, craftsmanship, confidence. Premium apparel designed for those who refuse to blend in.

story.title: THE DE FLORES STORY
story.description: De Flores stemmed from a young fashion designer's passion for crafting unique and novel style statements — to create a distinction. Translating to 'flowers' in Spanish, the name symbolises elegance, chastity, and loveliness in every attire we design. With a profusion of colours, high-calibre fabric, and aesthetic appeal, De Flores is a one-stop designer boutique for every woman who wants to flaunt an enchanting style.

founder.name: Anisree Sreeraj
founder.bio: A designer by instinct and a perfectionist by craft. Anisree founded De Flores to give every woman a wardrobe that feels like her own — designed, not selected. From bridal heirlooms to contemporary pret, each commission carries her signature: thoughtful silhouettes, refined colour, and embroidery that tells a story.
